title: Oakland and Berkeley Rent Increases for 2027: The New Numbers, and Which One Applies to Each Unit

findings.quote: Confirm the unit is registered with the Rent Adjustment Program when the increase is served, the first increase is at least 12 months after move-in, any prior increase was at least 12 months ago, and at least six months have passed since the tenant first received the RAP Notice.
findings.root_cause: Partially fixed, then regressed: registration, elapsed-time and tax-document checks were added, but the response explicitly removed the RAP Notice attachment bullet. The six-month prerequisite does not replace giving the required notice with every increase. Oakland's live allowable-increases page, RAP Notice Changes, confirms both duties. Snapshot checked: knowledge/sources/local/oakland/omc-8.22-art1-rent-adjustment.txt, §8.22.070H (notice requirements) and §8.22.060. Live source: https://www.oaklandca.gov/Community/Housing-Programs-Support/For-Landlords/Allowable-Rent-Increases/Learn-More-About-Allowable-Rent-Increases
findings.fix: Add a separate bullet: 'Include a copy of the City’s RAP Notice with every rent increase notice.' Keep the new registration, timing and tax-document bullets; the attachment is an additional requirement.
findings.future_prevention: Do not delete independently applicable duties when adding a different notice prerequisite.

findings.quote: Expire 5 years after accruing (10 years for amounts that accrued before Jan 1, 2026)
findings.root_cause: New evidence conflict introduced in round 02. The table grants a 10-year window based on accrual date; the newly cited May 28, 2026 info sheet reportedly supports that interpretation, but its live URL returned 403. The reviewed ordinance snapshot, knowledge/sources/local/oakland/omc-8.22-art1-rent-adjustment.txt §8.22.070B.5.c, says five years without that accrual-date grandfather. The City's live page describes a pre-2026 notice-service exception instead. The 10-year entitlement is not cleared; this is a source-reconciliation finding, not an assertion that the inaccessible PDF says something it does not. EVD-UNCERTAINTY-HANDLING and EVD-BLOCK-PENDING-VERIFICATION apply.
findings.fix: Replace the table's entire banking-expiration row and the body's accrual-date sentence with: 'Banked CPI increases are subject to expiration and other eligibility limits. Check Oakland’s current banking rules before including older amounts.' Link 'current banking rules' to the City’s allowable-increases page. If retaining a specific grandfather rule instead, reconcile the current ordinance and City publications first and cite the controlling provision; do not retain the 10-year promise while the conflict is unresolved.
findings.future_prevention: Reconcile a new agency summary against the saved ordinance before promoting a claim to verified. Correct the corresponding rent-caps.md assertion in a separately authorized reference update.
